title: Sales Consultant
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
experience: This is an exciting opportunity for someone with previous sales experience, excellent communication skills, and an interest in luxury products and the powersports industry
description_text:
Our client, a company specialising in premium powersports vehicles and luxury water toys, is seeking a motivated and commercially driven Sales Consultant to join its showroom team in Malta. The successful candidate will represent an exclusive portfolio of internationally recognised brands, including Sea-Doo, Can-Am, Flite Boards, and Seabob, offering high-end products to a discerning clientele. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with previous sales experience, excellent communication skills, and an interest in luxury products and the powersports industry.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Welcome and engage with customers visiting the showroom, providing a high-quality sales experience.
 Promote and sell premium powersports products, including jet skis, electric surfboards, and luxury superyacht water toys.
 Understand customers' needs and recommend suitable products based on their preferences and requirements.
 Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring a personalised customer experience.
 Manage sales enquiries, follow up with prospective customers, and convert leads into sales.
 Present product features, benefits, and technical specifications to potential buyers.
 Support product demonstrations and allow customers to experience selected demo products.
 Achieve individual sales targets and contribute to the overall performance of the showroom.
 Requirements 
 Residing in Malta 
 Fluent in Maltese and English 
 Previous experience in sales is essential.
 Strong communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
 Confident, charismatic, and customer-oriented personality.
 Commercial awareness and a results-driven mindset.
 Ability to build relationships and engage with high-end clientele.
 Interest in powersports, marine products, luxury goods, or similar industries will be considered an asset.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 What's on Offer 
 Competitive base salary plus commission.
 Opportunity to represent exclusive, world-class international brands.
 Access to premium products and demo experiences.
 Exposure to high-end clientele and industry professionals.
 Dynamic and energetic showroom environment.
 Career growth opportunities within an expanding luxury market.
 If you are a confident sales professional with a passion for premium products, excellent communication skills in Maltese and English, and a desire to work within the luxury powersports industry, we would love to hear from you.
